collection.title: Citroen C5 Aircross 2018 to 2025 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Citroen C5 Aircross 2018 Onwards model requires a 27" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" blade on the passengers side, however some brands recommend 28" & 16". All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment. We also have a Rear Wiper Blade for this C5 Aircross, simply click on the Rear Wiper Blade tab below.
